title: Metello
scene: Italian historical drama; labour movement cinema
notes: A wistful melodic theme contrasts with labour-strike laments, ceremonial marches and intimate acoustic colours.

title: La Califfa
scene: Italian social melodrama; orchestral film scoring
notes: Oboe and sweeping strings soften a tragic industrial drama, offset by dissonant textures and choirs.

title: Sacco e Vanzetti
scene: Italian political cinema; American protest folk
notes: Baez’s protest ballads and repeated anthem frame an austere orchestral account of political injustice.

title: Giù la testa
scene: Italian spaghetti western; Mexican Revolution cinema
notes: Wordless soprano, whistles and recurring sung-name calls connect revolutionary tragedy with offbeat orchestral humour.
